worldcombat.skill.fissure.summary: Press the shock into the soil and let a seam run along the ground to open beneath the foe: whoever stands on that patch is taken in one blow. It reaches far, but only recognises grounded targets that Ground can touch; the warning window before it opens is the foe's chance to walk away.
worldcombat.skill.fissure.description.0: The seam runs up to %1$s blocks along the ground and opens a %2$s block pit under the target; the locked target, if still standing inside, is finished in one blow - defence, armour and toughness are ignored, and only type immunity can stop it.
worldcombat.skill.fissure.description.1: There are %1$s s between locking the spot and the pit opening; every level above the target shortens it, and the target must step off or jump away in that time.
worldcombat.skill.fissure.description.2: The torn seam stays for %1$s s, tearing up to %2$s blocks of natural ground along the path and around the pit before the original blocks return.
worldcombat.skill.fissure.deep.on: Deep form: a larger pit and a longer-lived seam, but the opening is delayed by 8 ticks - a wider trap the target is also more likely to escape.
worldcombat.skill.fissure.deep.off: Quick form: opens sooner and recharges faster, but a smaller pit and a shorter seam.
worldcombat.skill.fissure.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s from the strike.
worldcombat.skill.fissure.growth.0: From level %1$s the pit radius rises to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.fissure.growth.1: From level %1$s the pit radius rises to %2$s blocks, the range to %3$s blocks and the seam lingers %4$s s.
worldcombat.skill.fissure.use.0: Delete a high-value grounded target from a distance
worldcombat.skill.fissure.use.1: Force a foe off its footing or into the air
worldcombat.skill.fissure.use.2: Leave a seam that marks where the ground is no longer safe
worldcombat.skill.fissure.preference.dee: On: pit x1.25 and a longer-lived seam (x1.35), but the opening is delayed by 8 ticks - a wider trap the target can escape more easily, for sealing ground or forcing movement. Off (quick form): opens sooner and recharges faster, but a smaller pit and a shorter seam, for finishing a target before it can leave.
The companion only considers fissure while the threat is within this distance; smaller keeps it to close range, larger opens from further away.
Below this health ratio the companion stops spending an instant kill on the target; higher keeps it for healthy foes only.
worldcombat.skill.fissure.description.gr: It can only be cast on a grounded enemy with a clear line of sight, and the user must be standing on the ground as well; airborne targets cannot be caught.
